forgot_password.heading: Recover your password
forgot_password.subtitle: Enter your pharmacy ID and registered phone number, and we will review your request.
forgot_password.pharmacy_id_hint: The ID given to you by the platform team at activation.
forgot_password.phone_hint: The same number registered on the pharmacy account.
forgot_password.err_generic: Could not submit the request right now. Please try again later.
forgot_password.success_body: If the pharmacy details match, the recovery request will be reviewed by the team.
forgot_password.success_note: After approval a new password is generated and sent to you through the platform approved channel. The current password keeps working until approval.
forgot_password.hero_desc: Request a password reset and we will contact you after the team review.
